title: Invitation consumption ledger memory-only: restart+identical-name recreation enables replay against fresh epochs
description: groups_collection.py consumed_invitations/invitations/retired_epochs volatile dicts, no persistence module-wide. Post-restart revoke-and-burn markers vanish; owner recreating same-named group (deterministic group_id from name) lets adversary re-record + re-spend still-valid signed invitation against new epoch keys. Mechanism confirmed; external restart+recreate precondition. Decision needed for owner: persist ledgers alongside group records or document service lifetime trust boundary.
notes: DECIDED: Ephemeral. Spec amended: 18.8.2 Trust Boundaries added -- restart clears revocation state, implementations MUST NOT persist ledgers. No code changes needed.
close_reason: Spec amended: documented as process-lifetime state, no persistence required
